GENERATIVE AI ANIMATOR?

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_single_image image="12965" img_size="full" alignment="center" onclick="link_image"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3" col_inner_shadow="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)" col_inner_shadow_hover="box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35" font_options="line_height:24"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-robot dfd_icon_set-icon-robot"]

The full animation pipeline, but art directed by a human.

Generative AI animation is only as good as the person directing it. Oddtoe brings twenty years of illustration, motion design, and visual storytelling experience to every frame — AI handles the scale, and a non-boring human handles the design and the judgement. Makes it an easier process for you, the client.

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-pencil_2 dfd_icon_set-icon-pencil_2"]

Illustration first. Always.

In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.  

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_icon_list icon_margin="10" icon_bottom_spase="10" icon_color="#f2f2f2" icon_dec_size="100" icon_border_radius="10" icon_border_style="dotted" icon_border_width="2" del_height="1" main_style="style-4" icon_size="35"][dfd_icon_list_item icon="dfd-icon-map_way dfd_icon_set-icon-map_way"]

Motion Design for Visual Facts

The integration of generative A.I. with traditional animation is a challenge. The design of non-fiction graphics, maps, and charts for a factual story is a challenge. Feeding the right data to a curiously-talented storyteller that happens to be a "bot"? That is a professional skill. 

[/dfd_icon_list_item][/dfd_icon_list][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="10" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="10" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="30"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="65" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="65" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_bg_style="canvas" dfd_enable_overlay="" css=".vc_custom_1776498629325{background-color: #332D26 !important;}" dfd_bg_color_value="#332D26"][vc_column][dfd_heading style="style_02" subtitle="Animation that treats the audience as intelligent." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Generative AI Animator in Australia, Outside of Hollywood[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The animators who work or have worked for Walt Disney all seem to come from Los Angeles. Maybe that's why movie animation all looks the same — either 2d Disney, 3d Pixar. At least, anime has given us new imagery and story types. But Hollywood animation isn't run by animators, but by studio heads who bear the risk for generating original stories and intellectual property (IP). Generative AI changes that equation. A small studio with the right tools and twenty years of animation experience can now produce work that would have required fifty people. That's what Oddtoe offers. Not a cheaper version of the same thing. Something genuinely different.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The subjects worth animating are rarely the easy ones. Science, history, technology, and deep dives into current events — that's where generative AI animation can help institutions and content creators that couldn't afford or lacked the talent to create beautiful explainers, animated videos, or documentary scenes.  Oddtoe is a generative AI animator. To me, Oddtoe is an animation house that can imagine 100 new animated comedies and kids' movies over breakfast. For ongoing clients, Oddtoe animates for YouTubers, helps influencers explain concepts better, or visualizes academic research in a way that is beyond what a typical university, think tank, or museum staffer could. These are clients who are telling stories that have a positive impact on their audiences; they're both educational and entertaining.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner Generative AI Animation

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="What is an AI animation studio?" tab_id="faqgai-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A studio that uses generative AI as one part of its animation pipeline rather than the whole of it. At Oddtoe the AI generates imagery and motion at a scale no single person could draw by hand, while the direction, design, rigging and edit are done the traditional way. There is a plain-language guide to the medium on the what is generative AI animation page.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Who works on an Oddtoe animation project?" tab_id="faqgai-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Oddtoe is a Melbourne studio of animators, designers, fabricators and technicians assembled around each project, and the whole pipeline runs through it — direction, character and background design, generative AI animation, rigging, motion design and the final edit. Art direction, project management and quality control stay in one pair of hands from brief to delivery, so nothing is handed off between an account team and the people actually making the work.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What does AI animation production actually involve?" tab_id="faqgai-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A hybrid workflow: generative AI animation for imagery and movement, advanced rigging for anything that has to stay consistent shot to shot, and traditional motion design for type, graphics and the edit. The mix changes per project — a branded loop and a factual explainer need very different amounts of each.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can generative AI animation be used for factual or documentary work?" tab_id="faqgai-4-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes, and it is where Oddtoe does most of its work — science, history, technology and deep dives into current events. Non-fiction animation needs accurate graphics, maps and charts as well as good-looking frames, so the motion design is directed rather than generated.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What kinds of projects suit generative AI animation?" tab_id="faqgai-5-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Branded content, YouTube channels, short films, and factual work where science, history, technology or current events need to be shown rather than described. Oddtoe also takes senior and ongoing roles on other studios’ animation projects.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Where is Oddtoe based?" tab_id="faqgai-6-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Melbourne, Australia, working with clients internationally. Oddtoe has produced work for organisations including National Geographic since 2006.

Looking for a

GENERATIVE AI ANIMATOR?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_single_image image=”12965″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center” onclick=”link_image”]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ col_inner_shadow=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)” col_inner_shadow_hover=”box_shadow_enable:disable|shadow_horizontal:0|shadow_vertical:15|shadow_blur:50|shadow_spread:0|box_shadow_color:rgba(0%2C0%2C0%2C.35)”]

  • The full animation pipeline, but art directed by a human.

    Generative AI animation is only as good as the person directing it. Oddtoe brings twenty years of illustration, motion design, and visual storytelling experience to every frame — AI handles the scale, and a non-boring human handles the design and the judgement. Makes it an easier process for you, the client.

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • Illustration first. Always.

    In my career, I have been a political cartoonist, a puppeteer, a data visualizer, and a street artist. But my foundational skill is illustration. Since 2006, Oddtoe has been around the block, working for such organizations such as National Geographic.  

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

  • Motion Design for Visual Facts

    The integration of generative A.I. with traditional animation is a challenge. The design of non-fiction graphics, maps, and charts for a factual story is a challenge. Feeding the right data to a curiously-talented storyteller that happens to be a “bot”? That is a professional skill. 

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_bg_style=”canvas” dfd_enable_overlay=”” css=”.vc_custom_1776498629325{background-color: #332D26 !important;}” dfd_bg_color_value=”#332D26″][vc_column]

Animation that treats the audience as intelligent.

Generative AI Animator in Australia, Outside of Hollywood

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]The animators who work or have worked for Walt Disney all seem to come from Los Angeles. Maybe that’s why movie animation all looks the same — either 2d Disney, 3d Pixar.

At least, anime has given us new imagery and story types.

But Hollywood animation isn’t run by animators, but by studio heads who bear the risk for generating original stories and intellectual property (IP).

Generative AI changes that equation. A small studio with the right tools and twenty years of animation experience can now produce work that would have required fifty people. That’s what Oddtoe offers. Not a cheaper version of the same thing. Something genuinely different.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]The subjects worth animating are rarely the easy ones. Science, history, technology, and deep dives into current events — that’s where generative AI animation can help institutions and content creators that couldn’t afford or lacked the talent to create beautiful explainers, animated videos, or documentary scenes. 

Oddtoe is a generative AI animator. To me, Oddtoe is an animation house that can imagine 100 new animated comedies and kids’ movies over breakfast. For ongoing clients, Oddtoe animates for YouTubers, helps influencers explain concepts better, or visualizes academic research in a way that is beyond what a typical university, think tank, or museum staffer could. These are clients who are telling stories that have a positive impact on their audiences; they’re both educational and entertaining.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
